title: Assassin's Apprentice
author: Robin Hobb

glossary.meaning: people whose minds were broken by the Forging. Mindless and soulless, but living humans, not ghosts or undead. They move in clans and fight as trained soldiers.
glossary.visual: pale, gaunt, dull-eyed, slack-faced, shabby clothes, stiff movements, blank expressions

glossary.meaning: the process that breaks a person's mind, leaving them Forged.
glossary.visual: cold grey light, dark stone chamber, a slumped figure with empty eyes, sense of dread

glossary.meaning: the Farseer ability that lets a person send and receive thoughts mind-to-mind over distance.
glossary.visual: a figure gone still with unfocused eyes, faint silvery shimmer around the head, dim firelight

glossary.meaning: an animal-bonding ability that lets a person share the senses and thoughts of an animal. Fitz is Wit-bonded to Nighteyes.
glossary.visual: a man and a grey wolf with dark eyes locked in a shared gaze, heads close together, dim forest light

glossary.meaning: the royal line of the Six Duchies, the family of the kings and princes, who carry the Skill.
glossary.visual: gold and scarlet royal clothing, strong jaws, heavy brows, dark eyes, stern expressions

glossary.meaning: the kingdom ruled by the Farseer kings, made up of six duchies, including Buck.
glossary.visual: rolling farmland, stone roads, coastal towns and villages, royal banners

glossary.meaning: the royal stronghold on the coast of Buck Duchy, seat of the Farseer kings.
glossary.visual: massive grey stone keep on a sea-facing headland, tall towers, stone walls, grey sea and harbour below, banners on the battlements

glossary.meaning: a separate kingdom in the mountains, home of Kettricken's people.
glossary.visual: snowy peaks, steep valleys, rough stone and timber halls, heavy wool and fur clothing

glossary.meaning: people from the Out Islands across the sea, who raid and trade with the Six Duchies.
glossary.visual: weathered sea-raiders in leather and mail, round shields, wind-whipped cloaks

glossary.meaning: the raiding longships of the Outislanders, with red sails, which attack the coasts of the Six Duchies.
glossary.visual: longships with red sails on a grey sea, smoke over a coastal village, armoured raiders on the shore

glossary.meaning: a child born outside marriage to a royal. Royal bastards take the Fitz prefix, as in FitzChivalry.
glossary.visual: young man in plain working clothes, guarded expression, standing apart from nobles in a royal hall

glossary.meaning: the king's secret killer. Chade is the king's assassin and trains Fitz in poisons, blades and disguise.
glossary.visual: dark hooded cloak, shadowy corridor, a concealed knife, watchful and cautious stance

visual_style:
Classic fantasy book illustration, retro fantasy art, traditional fantasy novel cover art, high-fantasy aesthetic.

Clean inked outlines, distinct line art, finely drawn contours, graphic novel style.

Muted and earthy color palette, cinematic lighting, warm ambient glow (especially from candles, torches, or hearth fires), soft directional shadows, painterly shading.

1990s epic fantasy paperback style, nostalgic fantasy illustration, atmospheric and moody storybook art.

Matte paper texture feel, subtle digital grain, clean digital painting with traditional ink-and-watercolor undertones.

Expressive fantasy characters, historically-inspired rustic medieval clothing (tunics, rough leather, cloaks, simple leather boots), grounded and non-glamorous fantasy design.

Immersive architectural details (rough stone walls, timber beams, medieval castle interiors or gritty coastal landscapes), lived-in and organic-looking spaces.

characters.name: Fitz
characters.description: young man around fifteen, tall, dark hair worn long and tied back, dark eyes, scar on the left shoulder, plain brown working clothes

characters.name: Molly
characters.description: young woman around seventeen, dark hair past her shoulders, plain blouse and red wool skirt

characters.name: Burrich
characters.description: stablemaster, wild black hair and beard, narrow angular face, weathered skin, brown eyes, long deft hands, slight limp, leather and wool working clothes

characters.name: Chade
characters.description: old man, robe the colour of undyed sheep's wool, untidy pale hair and beard, face pitted with small pink pox scars, bony hands with papery white skin and angry red scars on the back of the left hand, green eyes

characters.name: Verity
characters.description: prince, stocky with a barrel chest and broad shoulders, square work-scarred fists, dark tousled hair, short dark unkempt beard, black eyes, heavy brows, muted woollen clothes with a buck's-head buckle

characters.name: Regal
characters.description: prince, beardless, brown hair smoothed and scented, jaw and eyes like Verity's, scarlet and primrose clothes, oversized cloak, cream lace-trimmed doublet, scarf fastened with a gold stag brooch with a green stone eye

characters.name: Shrewd
characters.description: the king, older man, freshly groomed hair and beard, immaculate clothes with silk at the throat, brown eyes

characters.name: Chivalry
characters.description: Fitz's father, tall and dark-haired, Fitz is said to look much like him

characters.name: Galen
characters.description: duke, about Burrich's age, prominent cheekbones, skinny cheeks, pale eyes, hawk nose, richly dressed with a fur-trimmed collar, amber-bead vest, snug tailored jacket, calf-high boots, chain of three gems

characters.name: Patience
characters.description: short slender woman, hazel eyes, straight mouth, dark curly hair she tries to tame with ringlets escaping at her forehead and neck

characters.name: Lacey
characters.description: round face, dimples

characters.name: Kettricken
characters.description: young woman, jade-green eyes, straight nose, solemn mouth, muscular arms, thick yellow hair in braids coiled around her head or loose down her back

characters.name: Rurisk
characters.description: older than Kettricken and very similar to her in face, jade eyes, straight nose, solemn mouth, hair cut very short at the collar

characters.name: August
characters.description: boy about thirteen, dark-toned hair, broad build like Verity

characters.name: Cob
characters.description: boy about ten, short dark hair

characters.name: Fool
characters.description: very pale skin with a faint pink tint, pale blue eyes, pale fluffy dandelion-yellow hair, small widely spaced white teeth, motley of black and white in winter or blue and red silk in summer

characters.name: Nighteyes
characters.description: grey wolf, green eyes as a cub and dark eyes as an adult, dark muzzle, buff fur at the ears and throat, coat flecked with stiff black hairs, very large feet

characters.name: Nosy
characters.description: hound with a stick-like tail, red fur and copper eyes as an adult

characters.name: Vixen
characters.description: old hound with a stick-like tail, whitened muzzle, one torn ear

characters.name: Smithy
characters.description: black terrier with a black nose, short smooth coat, thick neck, white spots on the chin and left hind foot
